ownership.quote: GitHub, headquartered in San Francisco, is operated by Github, Inc., a subsidiary of Microsoft since 2018.

stage.quote: On June 4, 2018, Microsoft announced its intent to acquire GitHub for US$7.5 billion (~$9.2 billion in 2024). The deal closed on October 26, 2018.
stage.note: GitHub Codespaces is a feature of GitHub, which has been a wholly owned Microsoft subsidiary since October 2018. Prior to acquisition GitHub had raised VC funding (notably a 2015 Series B from Sequoia/Andreessen Horowitz/others reported around $250M+ total), but that funding history is no longer meaningful post-acquisition; product stage is coded as subsidiary/public (Microsoft, NASDAQ: MSFT).

total_funding_usd.basis: Microsoft's acquisition price for GitHub, per company announcement and press coverage, is treated here as the terminal 'funding' event (full buyout) rather than a sum of prior VC rounds.
total_funding_usd.quote: On June 4, 2018, Microsoft announced its intent to acquire GitHub for US$7.5 billion (~$9.2 billion in 2024).

revenue.basis: Reported by Microsoft; figure is for GitHub as a whole (all products: repos, Actions, Copilot, Codespaces, etc.), not Codespaces specifically.
revenue.quote: Microsoft says GitHub now has a $1B ARR, 90M active users

note: GitHub Codespaces is a product/feature of GitHub, Inc., which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Microsoft (acquired 2018 for $7.5B, deal closed October 2018). No separate funding rounds or revenue figures exist for Codespaces itself; all financials are at the GitHub or Microsoft (public, NASDAQ: MSFT) level. No accelerator/incubator affiliation found or applicable.
